fields.hero_heading_em: graded by stem and packed by the box
fields.hero_body: Export-grade roses from our Nairobi farm — standard and spray varieties graded 40 to 90cm, ordered by whole boxes, quoted and confirmed by the people who pack them.
fields.process_heading_em: confirmed quotation in one working day
fields.footer_tagline: Export-grade roses grown in Nairobi, graded by stem length and packed to whole boxes — ordered online, confirmed by people who know the farm.

process_steps.title: Build your basket by the box
process_steps.description: Browse live availability and pick stems by variety and grade. The cart shows how your stems fill each box type and what is still needed to reach a whole box.

process_steps.title: Ask for a quotation
process_steps.description: Send your basket with a PO reference. We confirm pricing, availability and freight within one working day.

process_steps.title: Accept & receive
process_steps.description: Accept online from your portal. We pack to order and ship cold chain, with documents in your portal.
